开饭啦！计时开始: Lunch is on! The clock has started
继续接菜、送桌；关门后用 token 升级。: Keep catching and serving. Spend your tokens on upgrades after closing.
随时按 Esc / Start 暂停。: Press Esc / Start to pause at any time.
把饭盒送上桌: Bring the box to the table
方向键 / WASD 移到右下角餐桌，按 E / Enter 拿盒。: Move to the bottom-right table with WASD / arrow keys. Press E / Enter to take a box.
方向键 / WASD 移动饭盒，接住一份落下的菜。: Move the box with WASD / arrow keys and catch a falling dish.
把饭盒移回右下角餐桌，按 E / Enter 送给她。: Bring the box to the bottom-right table. Press E / Enter to serve.
左摇杆移到右下角餐桌，按 A 拿盒。: Move to the bottom-right table with the left stick. Press A to take a box.
左摇杆移动饭盒，接住一份落下的菜。: Move the box with the left stick and catch a falling dish.
把饭盒移回右下角餐桌，按 A 送给她。: Bring the box to the bottom-right table. Press A to serve.
把鼠标移到右下角餐桌，点击拿盒。: Move the mouse to the bottom-right table and click to take a box.
移动鼠标，把饭盒放在落下的菜下面。: Move the mouse to place your box under a falling dish.
把饭盒移回右下角餐桌，点击送给她。: Bring the box to the bottom-right table and click to serve.
先完成一次送餐，再开始计时。不用装满也能送。: The clock starts after your first delivery. The box does not need to be full.
